concurrency.title: Concurrent scans
concurrency.description: How many stores the scraper scans at a time. Lowering it lets the running scans finish, new scans wait until there is room. A Solr reindex and config tests do not count.
concurrency.label: Stores at a time
concurrency.saved: Saved, the scraper applies it within a few seconds

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.description: Runs the full crawl and active products schedules of the stores. Turning it off stops the schedules of every store without changing them. Scans started by hand still run, and queued and running scans are not cancelled.
scheduler.label: Run scheduled scans
scheduler.savedOn: Scheduler turned on, the scraper applies it within 30 seconds
scheduler.savedOff: Scheduler turned off, the scraper applies it within 30 seconds
